channel.title: KnowYourSponsor: Visa sponsors added and removed in healthcare & care
channel.description: Employers in Healthcare & Care that gained or lost a licence to sponsor UK work visas. Rebuilt every day from the official GOV.UK register. Covers the last 7 days.
